capabilities: Capture memos into Daily Notes without opening a file
Collect memos into monthly Markdown files
Browse, filter, and search memos as cards
Revisit old memos via random revisit, shuffle day, and date markers
extras: README documents detailed draft-recovery limits and data-safety advice, including backing up the vault before first use; search supports multi-keyword AND only as a future candidate.
intentEvidence: If you need a mature and feature-rich Memos plugin, Thino may be a better fit.
motivation: The author built it to give fragmented thoughts a low-friction entry point, since many thoughts arrive as sentence-sized pieces rather than polished notes.
problem: Obsidian's workflow expects fragments to be filed into the right note, folder, and structure, so fleeting thoughts often never get written down.

relations.evidence: Thino is a mature Obsidian Memos plugin.
flomo is a standalone Memos product. Knomo is an Obsidian plugin.

summary: Local-first memo capture layer that writes quick memos into Daily Notes and monthly Markdown files, with card browsing, filters, and review.
